name: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen
summary: English-medium joint-venture university in Shenzhen, China; undergraduate programmes are approved by CUHK, which issues CUHK degrees.

handoff.label: International undergraduate entry and programme guidance

ib.text: 2027 entry: full IB Diploma with 30/45, plus relevant subjects. IB English at SL or HL grade 4 meets English evidence. Admission is competitive; Financial Engineering and Clinical Medicine have extra rules.

dates.label: Late Round, no conditional offers, 23:59:59 China time

programmes.name: Financial Engineering
programmes.about: An English-taught quantitative finance degree jointly offered by management and economics, science and engineering, and data science, with Quantitative Finance and FinTech streams.
programmes.overview: Students combine financial theory with mathematics, computational methods and data analysis. The Quantitative Finance stream emphasises securities, derivative instruments and pricing, while the FinTech stream applies data science to financial services. The school lists foundational finance and microeconomics alongside data structures, investment analysis, financial-data analysis and optional machine learning. Students select a stream within one degree, rather than applying for a separate degree for each stream. The programme supports finance- and technology-related progression.

flagshipSource.title: Three-school Financial Engineering programme with Quantitative Finance and FinTech streams

programmes.selectionNote: Academic and non-academic record review; some applicants are invited to interview. Quantitative preparation and programme-specific conditions apply.
programmes.ib: Strong mathematics preparation is expected. Confirm the Financial Engineering supplementary requirements; no IB AA/AI or HL/SL grade conversion is published.

programmes.name: Artificial Intelligence
programmes.about: A four-year engineering bachelor's degree dedicated to AI fundamentals and applications, taught through an interdisciplinary foundation followed by specialist study and practical projects.
programmes.overview: In the first two years, students build foundations in mathematics, physics, programming and introductory artificial intelligence. The second half of the degree develops specialised work in areas such as AI theory, embodied AI, scientific applications and business applications. The school describes small-group, mentor-led research and collaborations with industry as part of advanced practical study. This combines theoretical understanding with building and applying AI systems, with pathways into technical careers or further research.

flagshipSource.title: Dedicated interdisciplinary AI engineering degree and research-oriented study pathways

programmes.selectionNote: Academic and non-academic record review; some applicants are invited to interview. A relevant science/engineering background is required.
programmes.ib: Relevant science and mathematics preparation is required; engineering applicants need adequate physics. The source gives no exact IB subjects, levels or grades.

notes: The late round makes no conditional offers, so it is unsuitable for applicants awaiting their May 2027 IB award; use an earlier round.
Foreign-nationality eligibility has additional conditions for some applicants with Chinese family or former nationality; attending school in Denmark does not settle this.
2027 tuition is CNY 162,000 a year. Housing, insurance and other charges are separate; scholarships are limited and require an award.
